summary: Explicitly expose unsupported replacement lineage while preserving the pending accounting and zero-fill cleanup barriers.
disposition: The broker lifecycle omission is real, but accepting replaced as an accounting-eligible terminal state is unsafe. Replaced-order accounting and cleanup support remain deferred; this patch fixes the ambiguous operational diagnosis and adds regression evidence.
reasoning: Alpaca documents replaced as another order or a corporate-action update, while pending_replace is still nonterminal.
Order has no typed replaces/replaced_by lineage. Stream updates persist status and cumulative fill summaries without authoritative updated replacement links.
Existing Execution rows are derived from cumulative Order summary deltas at cumulative average prices; they are not an independent replacement cashflow oracle.
Observed broker flatness, balanced Order summaries, or hypothetical reciprocal attributes do not prove a complete nonduplicated replacement lifetime.
ACCOUNTABLE_TERMINAL_STATUSES intentionally preserves the prior accounting-eligible set, which differs from the full broker lifecycle vocabulary.

Replaced rows retain pending status with accounting_hold_reason=replacement_lineage_unverified. A successful later lookup with no replacement evidence clears this diagnostic, without changing the original close time/reason.
The prior conservative lifetime scope is preserved, including older same-symbol replaced orders that may have an unknown successor. No histories or stored broker records are altered.
regressions: Zero-filled replaced predecessor with missing, new, pending_replace, canceled, or filled successor remains pending.
Partial-filled replaced predecessor plus a filled successor and complete balancing exit remains pending even with reciprocal attributes and matching summary-derived Execution rows.
Repeat and restart preserve the original observed-flat bound and reason; ledger, learner, Kelly, calibration, and completed-entry receipts do not advance.
A later independently complete symbol remains behind the unresolved replacement close in the deterministic queue.
Pending_replace, pending_cancel, done_for_day, stopped, and calculated never become eligible for zero-fill cleanup or exact accounting.
A stale replacement diagnostic cannot block a supported exact -2 close once current evidence no longer has replacement ambiguity.
